text: On the left side of Harbour City's defensive half near their own penalty area, Tariq Marlowe of Seabrook Town makes a strong tackle to win the ball high up the pitch. Within a single second, Marlowe immediately shoots from about 10 metres out, straight ahead of the goal at the Harbour City end. The shot finds the net, cutting Harbour City's lead to 2-1 in this quick, direct counter-attack[#1103] [#1104].
